invariants.rationale: The method always returns the result of the add() method, which returns a non-null Cell.
The Cell<Label> added is constructed with a new Label, so getActor() should never be null.
The actor added to the cell is always a Label.
The Label is constructed with a (possibly new) LabelStyle, which should not be null.
The LabelStyle used for the Label uses the font obtained from skin.getFont(fontName).
